the best rank- 1 approximation of a higher-order supersymmetric tensor can be obtained by solving the corresponding unconstrained optimization problem, which in turn can be solved using a symmetric version of higher-order power method with a guaranteed convergence, provided that the objective functional is convex or concave, and that a suitable initialization of the iterative process is available.

(1) the higher-order power method converges to the global optimum of the least-squares functional if it is either convex or concave, (2) the initialization method developed here is more effective than the previous one and its proximity to the optimum is a prior i quantifiable, and (3) the square matrix unfolding of a supersymmetric tensor satisfies some important properties.
